item.title: The One-Step Trap (In AI Research)
item.description:

item.title: Show HN: Zen Mode – a global focus mode for macOS
item.description:
📝 Live window tracking — drag or resize the window while Zen Mode is active and the cutout follows it; if the window closes, the overlay tears itself down. They are passive, always-on effects: they don't touch the desktop wallpaper, Menu Bar, or Dock, and they never move or resize your window. It doesn't reposition the window or hide the Menu Bar and Dock.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/cabeen/zen-mode
